items.headline: Guinea-Bissau me chunav 2028 tak tale
items.detail: Sainya sarkar ne December me hone wale rashtrapati aur sansadiya chunav November 2028 tak taal diye; nagrik shasan ki vapasi me 2 saal ki deri hogi.
items.exam_angle: Guinea-Bissau, sainya takhtapalat, ECOWAS — UPSC IR

items.headline: Venezuela vipaksh par pratibandh wala kanoon hataega
items.detail: National Assembly 2024 ke Simon Bolivar kanoon ko radd karegi, jo pratibandhon ke samarthan par vipaksh ko saarvajanik pad se rokta tha.

items.headline: Bharat-America sambandh ke sutradhar Talbott ka nidhan
items.detail: America ke poorv up-videsh mantri Strobe Talbott, 80, ka nidhan ho gaya; Pokhran-II ke baad Bharat-America baatchit me unki badi bhoomika thi.
items.exam_angle: Strobe Talbott, Bharat-America sambandh, Pokhran-II — UPSC IR

items.headline: Pakistan ke Zeeshan Ali Tiangong par pahunche
items.detail: China ke Shenzhou-24 mission me Pakistan ke Muhammad Zeeshan Ali Tiangong station par pahunche — pehle videshi astronaut.
items.image_credit: China News Service, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Riyadh tower par Houthi hamla, 11 ghayal
items.detail: Drone hamle me 2 Bharatiya samet 11 log ghayal hue; Bharat ne hamle ki ninda ki aur hamle turant rokne ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: Houthi, Saudi Arabia, Riyadh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Vietnam-America vyapar samjhota, tariff 35% se kam
items.detail: Vietnam ke PM Le Minh Hung ne kaha America se vyapar samjhota lagbhag tay ho gaya hai; America ka prastavit 35% tariff isse bahut kam hoga, aur dono desh hastakshar ki taiyari kar rahe hain.
items.exam_angle: Vietnam-America vyapar, Section 301 tariff — UPSC economy/IR

items.headline: Bangkok tel depot me dhamaka, 7 ghayal
items.detail: Bangkok ke Bangchak tel depot me dhamake aur aag se 7 log ghayal hue, jinme 4 ki haalat gambhir hai; refinery ki sabhi unit band kar di gayin aur aag par kabu pa liya gaya.

items.headline: China: Shanghai neta Chen Jining jaanch me
items.detail: China ke bhrashtachar-rodhi vibhag ne Shanghai ke party pramukh aur Politburo sadasya Chen Jining ki jaanch shuru ki; woh 2022 ke baad jaanch me aaye chauthe Politburo sadasya hain.

items.headline: America me toofan: 9 lakh bina bijli
items.detail: Thanksgiving par aaye toofan se America ke purvi hisse me 9 lakh se zyada ghar bijli ke bina rahe; Macy's parade 100 saal me pehli baar tali aur 400 udanein radd hui.

items.headline: Cairo me tanker aag: 31 mare
items.detail: Cairo ki Ring Road par tel tanker palatne se lagi aag me 31 log mare aur 21 ghayal hue; 27 gaadiyan jal gayin aur zimmedar driver giraftar hua.

items.headline: SpaceX ko 10 lakh satellite ki manzoori
items.detail: America ke FCC ne SpaceX ko antariksh me AI data centre ke liye 10 lakh satellite bhejne ki manzoori di; pehla satellite 2033 tak bhejna hoga.

items.headline: De Cos banenge ECB ke naye pramukh
items.detail: Eurozone ke netaon ne Spain ke Pablo Hernandez de Cos ko ECB ka agla pramukh chuna; woh February me Christine Lagarde ki jagah lenge.

items.headline: Congo me Ebola: 12,000 case, 5,904 maut
items.detail: Congo me Ebola ke mamle 12,021 ho gaye aur 5,904 mautein hui; purvi hisse me ladai ke karan madad pahunchana mushkil ho raha hai.

items.headline: Houthi hamla: Saudi refinery me Nepali mara
items.detail: Saudi Arabia ki Jazan refinery par Houthi hamle me ek Nepali mazdoor mara gaya aur kai ghayal hue; aag lagi aur kuchh hissa band hua.
items.exam_angle: Houthi, Saudi Arabia, Yemen yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Indonesia khadan baadh: 13 mare, 13 laapata
items.detail: Indonesia ke Bogor me gair-kanuni sone ki khadan me baadh se 13 mazdoor mare gaye aur 13 abhi 100 meter gehri khadan me fanse hain.

items.headline: Russia ne Kyiv par missile hamla kiya
items.detail: Russia ne raat me Kyiv par ballistic missile se hamla kiya; ek shopping centre aur 2 imaratein nishana bani, 7 log ghayal hue.

items.headline: FIFA par cyber hamla, data chori hua
items.detail: FIFA ne kaha woh ek cyber hamle ka shikar hui, jisme vyaktigat aur vyavsayik jankari churai gayi; hamlaawaron ne staff bankar ghuspaith ki.

items.headline: Trump: Putin G20 me aa sakte hain
items.detail: Trump ne kaha, Putin chahein to 14-15 December ko Miami me hone wale G20 sammelan me aa sakte hain; nimantran pehle se hai, Kremlin ne abhi faisla nahi liya.

items.headline: Kuwait me drone hamle me 2 Italian mare
items.detail: Kuwait ke ek hawai raksha kendra par drone hamle me Rheinmetall Italia ke 2 technician mare gaye; Italy aur Kuwait ne Iran par aarop lagaya, Iran ne inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Kuwait, Iran, drone hamla — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cuba ke paas jahaz dooba, 1 ki maut
items.detail: Panama jhande wala cargo jahaz Halima Cuba ke Artemisa tat ke paas doob gaya; 16 me se 13 mile, jinme ek ki maut hui, 3 abhi laapata hain.

items.headline: China ne Taiwan ke saamne landing abhyaas kiya
items.detail: China ne Fujian ke Dacheng Bay me nagrik jahazon ko jodkar lagbhag 800 meter lamba tairta pul banakar Taiwan par utarne ka abhyaas kiya; Taiwan ke raksha mantralaya ne kaha woh is gatividhi par nazar rakhe hue hai.

items.headline: Drone Latvia ki hawai seema me ghusa
items.detail: Shukravaar subah ek ajnaat drone thodi der ke liye Latvia ki hawai seema me ghusa; NATO ke ladaku viman aur interceptor drone bheje gaye, koi nuksan nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Latvia, NATO, drone ghuspaith — UPSC IR

items.headline: Duterte ka ICC mukadma Somvaar se
items.detail: Philippines ke poorv rashtrapati Rodrigo Duterte par ICC me manavta ke khilaf apraadh ka mukadma 30 November se shuru hoga; unpar 2011-2019 ke beech 85 hatyaon ke aarop hain.
items.exam_angle: ICC, Philippines, manavta ke khilaf apraadh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Erdogan ne Mecca raksha samjhota manzoor kiya
items.detail: Turkey ke rashtrapati Erdogan ne Pakistan aur Saudi Arabia ke saath Mecca sanyukt raksha samjhote ko aupcharik manzoori di; sansad ne ise 5 November ko pass kiya tha.
items.exam_angle: Turkey, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia raksha samjhota — UPSC IR
